'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] launch a massive aerial bombardment on [[Gaza City]], killing 123 people across the [[Gaza Strip]], amid reports that the [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli Army]] is about to enter the city. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyj0dd0qj9o (BBC News)] [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2025/0813/1528215-israel-gaza/ (RTÉ News)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Three soldiers are killed and four others are injured in a [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] by [[FARC dissidents]] on members of the [[Colombian Navy]] and [[Military Forces of Colombia|Armed Forces]] who were manning a checkpoint on the [[Naya River]] in south-west [[Colombia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwypn46k1l5o?xtor=AL-71-%5Bpartner%5D-%5Bbbc.news.twitter%5D-%5Bheadline%5D-%5Bnews%5D-%5Bbizdev%5D-%5Bisapi%5D&at_link_id=1397D448-7846-11F0-802A-D9430ADB14A0&at_link_type=web_link&at_campaign_type=owned&at_format=link&at_link_origin=BBCWorld&at_campaign=Social_Flow&at_ptr_name=twitter&at_bbc_team=editorial&at_medium=social (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two children and a woman are killed by a [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] in [[Bajaur]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], amidst fighting between the [[Pakistani Armed Forces|Pakistani military]] and [[Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan]] fighters. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-military-offensive-civilian-deaths-northwest-d9011ffc7ed753c66c9eb70d55f94057 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Fashion]] [[retail]]er [[Claire's]] collapses into [[Administration (law)|administration]] in the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], putting more than 2,150 jobs at risk, amid declining sales and strong competition from [[online shopping]] services. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8zwdy98k8o (BBC News)]
*Canadian [[textile industry|clothing]] company [[Gildan]] finalizes the details for its [[mergers and acquisitions|acquisition]] of American company [[Hanesbrands]] for US$2.2 billion. [https://apnews.com/article/gildan-hanesbrands-hanes-maidenform-57b14618d7611f4a644af4150049502e (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Podul (2025)|Typhoon Podul]] makes landfall in southern [[Taiwan]], killing one person, injuring 112 people, leaving one missing, causing hundreds of flight cancellations, thousands of evacuations, school closures and blackouts. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/13/typhoon-podul-intensifies-on-approach-to-southern-taiwan (Al Jazeera)] [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202508130024 (Focus Taiwan)] [https://udn.com/news/story/7320/8937234 (United Daily News)]
*Twenty-six people are killed and several others are missing after a boat carrying migrants capsizes off the coast of [[Lampedusa]], [[Sicily]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ansa.it/amp/sito/notizie/cronaca/2025/08/13/barca-di-migranti-si-ribalta-a-lampedusa-almeno-20-morti_aa358403-ad59-44cd-9a7a-ac8ec345c3a8.html (Ansa)] [https://apnews.com/article/migrants-killed-shipwreck-italy-lampedusa-6ad5d9710e8e8f47116111fe6e6fb29d (AP)]
*Thirteen people are killed and 50 others become ill, including 21 cases of blindness or impaired vision and some critically, from [[methanol poisoning]] in [[Kuwait]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/tainted-alcohol-leaves-13-asians-dead-21-blinded-kuwait-health-ministry-says-2025-08-14/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and five others are injured when a [[hot air balloon]] carrying 34 people crashes near [[De Hoeve]], [[Friesland]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2578580-een-dode-en-gewonden-bij-ongeluk-met-luchtballon-in-friesland-door-windvlaag (NOS)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Sudanese cholera epidemic (2024–present)|Sudanese cholera epidemic]]
***[[Sudan]]ese [[Health in Sudan|health authorities]] launch a ten-day [[cholera]] [[Cholera vaccine|vaccination campaign]] in [[Khartoum]] targeting over 150,000 people to curb an outbreak that has caused more than 83,000 cases and 2,100 deaths nationwide since July 2024. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-cholera-khartoum-disease-united-nations-vaccine-c4d165a34fc2538fd7b78c886bb6cd57 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Vanuatu relations]]
**[[Australia]] and [[Vanuatu]] agree to implement a A$500 million (US$327 million) deal over the next decade to provide funding for [[Economy of Vanuatu|economic development]], security cooperation, labour mobility, and [[climate resilience]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/australia-vanuatu-agree-325-million-security-economic-pact-amid-china-2025-08-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Euthanasia in Uruguay]]
**The [[Uruguay]]an [[Chamber of Representatives of Uruguay|Chamber of Representatives]] votes 64–35 to [[Legality of euthanasia|decriminalize]] [[euthanasia]]. The bill moves to the [[Senate of Uruguay|Senate]] for approval. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/uruguays-lower-house-parliament-votes-favor-euthanasia-2025-08-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Internal conflict in Peru]]
**[[Peru]]vian [[President of Peru|president]] [[Dina Boluarte]] signs into [[Law of Peru|law]] a [[Congress of the Republic of Peru|congressional]] bill granting [[amnesty]] to all [[Peruvian Armed Forces|military]], [[National Police of Peru|police]], and other self-defense personnel accused of [[Human rights in Peru|human rights]] violations committed between 1980 and 2000. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/13/peru-amnesty-military-police-human-rights-abuses (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Malaysia]]n [[Federal Court of Malaysia|Federal Court]] rules that an [[addendum order]] allegedly allowing former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|prime minister]] [[Najib Razak]] to serve the remainder of his [[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal|1MDB]]-related prison sentence under [[house arrest]] exists, but refers the matter to the [[High court (Malaysia)|High Court]] to determine its validity. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysias-top-court-allows-jailed-ex-pm-najib-pursue-legal-bid-house-arrest-2025-08-13/ (Reuters)]
